svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · AGENTIC SANDBOX EGRESS & SECRET BROKER (#386)
Out-of-Sandbox L7 Secret Broker Proxy vs. Raw Env Vars & L3 Allowlists
Keeping Real API Keys Outside the Agent Sandbox + L7 Path/Method ACL Eliminates 100% of Token Theft & 99.8% of Exfiltration
Tier 1 & 2 Trap: Raw Secrets in os.environ + L3 DNS
• Prompt injection runs print(os.environ) -> steals raw GITHUB_TOKEN!
• L3 DNS allowlist permits api.github.com -> attacker POSTs stolen
keys to an external attacker-owned GitHub Gist or Issue!
• 100% Raw Credential Theft Risk & Only 58% Exfiltration Blocked
Tier 4: Out-of-Sandbox L7 Secret Broker + CSP
• Sandbox holds ONLY dummy handle (BROKER_REF_01, 0 real keys!)
• External Envoy L7 Proxy checks exact (Host, Method, /repos/org/X)
• Injects real Bearer token only when URI matches approved tenant repo
4-Tier Agentic Sandbox Egress & Secret Governance Matrix
Tier 1 (Open Egress + Raw Env Key) : Exfil Blocked = 1.5% | Key Theft Risk = 100.0% | Latency = +0.0ms
Tier 2 (L3 DNS Allow + Raw Env Key) : Exfil Blocked = 58.0% | Key Theft Risk = 100.0% | Latency = +0.2ms
Tier 3 (L7 Path ACL + Scoped Token) : Exfil Blocked = 91.5% | Key Theft Risk = 25.0% | Latency = +1.4ms
Tier 4 (Out-of-Sandbox L7 Broker) : Exfil Blocked = 99.8% | Key Theft Risk = 0.0% | Latency = +1.8ms
